paragraphs: Embedded Software Developer with 4+ years of experience delivering validated, production-grade software in semiconductor and systems engineering environments. I consistently reduce defect escape rates, accelerate validation cycles, and improve system reliability through Python automation and low-level Linux debugging.

I hold an M.S. in Computer Science (4.0 GPA) and a B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, which lets me bridge firmware-level hardware understanding with full-stack system software skills. At AMD I automate validation test harnesses, root-cause high-severity Linux-layer defects, and build data-collection pipelines across large test fleets.

Earlier, at Inventive Core Integrations, I delivered Python automation and backend modules that eliminated ~15 hours/week of manual engineering effort and improved deployment reliability. I'm comfortable in fast-paced Agile environments, collaborating closely across hardware, validation, and software teams.
